synthesis_metadata.volume: Uncomfortable Situations: Emotion between Science and the Humanities
synthesis_metadata.author: Daniel M. Gross

tensions.pole_A: Darwin's Expression of the Emotions is a rhetorical-interpretive science with cast-of-characters specification and interpretive caveats built in (E 21, E 260).
tensions.pole_B: Darwin's photographic-illustration method underwrites a decontextualized basic-emotions program (Ekman's editorial reception and FACS heritage).
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Darwin disentangled from heavy-handed editor Ekman; photographs read as arguments, not as basic-emotion evidence.

tensions.tension_name: Galenic disequilibrium vs. socially-negotiated mixed feelings
tensions.pole_A: Mixed feelings as proportional internal mixings of humours (Galen, Paster, Phileban remedial homeostasis).
tensions.pole_B: Mixed feelings as negotiated convergences of contradictory norms on a focal character (Austen, Kahneman-Miller norm theory, Barrett-Barsalou situated conceptualization).
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Anti-Galenic: mixed feelings are negotiated circumstances converging on character, demonstrated through Edward and Marianne in Sense and Sensibility.

tensions.pole_A: Cognitive Approaches to Literature (Zunshine, Vermeule, Crane) read characters via theory-of-mind / mind-reading inferences.
tensions.pole_B: Austen's withheld omniscience and Kahneman-Miller norm-theory show that resource distribution and norm-establishment, not mind-reading, are the operative dynamics.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Mind-reading approaches are unecological; Austen calculatedly withholds omniscient narration so feeling becomes legible only through occasion and norm.

tensions.pole_A: Gibson holds affordances are 'always there to be perceived' as invariants of the species-environment relation, prelinguistically and pre-culturally.
tensions.pole_B: Cop-car-roof becomes a speaking-platform only after Mario Savio (1964); Aristotle's Cydias case constitutes threat through storytelling — affordances are historically fixed and rhetorically constituted.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Both invariance and variance obtain at different analytic levels; rhetoric is a humanistic affordance theory that abandons Gibson's invariance criterion to capture hostile environments.

tensions.tension_name: Consoling situated cognition vs. uncomfortable situatedness
tensions.pole_A: Dreyfus, Chalmers, Clark, Wheeler, Thompson, Noë treat situated/extended cognition as homely scaffolding — jazz, fabric of mind, cultural return-home.
tensions.pole_B: Lewin's hopeless situation, Wittgenstein 1938 discomfort, Ahmed's queer phenomenology, Freud's unheimlich supply a Gestalt-queer counter-tradition: cognition is practically situated but uncomfortably so.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Dominant situated-cognition metaphors are bourgeois return-home rhetoric repressing alienation; the volume's titular wedge sits between EM-theory and the uncomfortable counter-tradition.

tensions.pole_A: Berlant (Cruel Optimism p.5): situation as 'a state of things in which something that will perhaps matter is unfolding.'
tensions.pole_B: Gross: situation is constituted by audience investments and emotional instability defined rhetorically; sentimental literature is the privileged research domain.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Supplements rather than refutes Berlant; rhetorical instability becomes constitutive — and Compassion's compassionate-conservatism critique extends to literary cognitivism.

tensions.pole_A: Kahneman's instant-utility / hedonic-treadmill / becoming-vs-being-paraplegic framework treats well-being as a measurable subjective state.
tensions.pole_B: Equiano's 'happily situated as a slave' refuses state-description through layered retrospection and 18th-c 'happy = by chance'; rhetorical analysis of well-being is load-bearing.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Equiano apparently slips into Kahneman's hedonic psychology but ultimately resists it; subjective-well-being measurement cannot survive the rhetorical analysis it presupposes.

tensions.pole_A: Common-fate / passionate-attachment models (Noë, orthodox Merleau-Pontian readings, Butler) register felt attachment as resonant intersubjectivity.
tensions.pole_B: Equiano's gratitude to Pascal (sold), attachment to King (defaulted) — Carretta's formula: interests can be vested differently from feelings, and felt attachment may be the vehicle of subjection.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Common-fate models cannot register asymmetric master-slave vested interests; pragmatic phenomenology requires supplementation by the Hegelian-Marxist strand of Merleau-Ponty.

tensions.pole_A: Afro-Pessimism (Sexton, Wilderson, Moten): black social death is structurally irreducible to any rhetoric of recognition or sympathy.
tensions.pole_B: Rhetorical-humanities methodology (Gross): preserve analytic registration of structural exclusion without collapsing into programmatic Afro-Pessimist negation.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Engagement without endorsement; Du Boisian double-consciousness is supplemented (Moten) but Equiano exceeds it through the rhetorical analytic.

tensions.pole_A: Scott (Lives of Novelists 1825): Radcliffe's Gothic resolves into Enlightenment disenchantment — supernatural elements are explained 'on natural principles at the winding up.'
tensions.pole_B: Gross: Radcliffe's transitional handling sustains spectrality — the supernatural slips through fingers, evades glances, just out of earshot, at the moment of concrete threat.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Real terror is fictional; nonreferring terms remain affectively load-bearing through Radcliffe's spectral technique.

tensions.pole_A: The Marquis offers Adeline 'honorable asylum' (Romance of the Forest p.125) as protection.
tensions.pole_B: In the rhetorical situation the same offer is coercive predation; the abbey is simultaneously domestic asylum (p.34) and potential slaughterhouse (p.338).
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: The rhetoric of affordances is precisely this inversion; affordance-redescription cannot be analyzed at the level of direct perception.

tensions.tension_name: Expected utility vs. prospect theory (Elinor vs. Marianne)
tensions.pole_A: Elinor's expected-utility framing of Edward-marrying-Lucy as absolute-value substitution (S&S p.198) — crass utilitarian averaging in the Benthamite mode.
tensions.pole_B: Marianne's retort 'if the loss of what is most valued is so easily to be made up by something else' prefigures Kahneman-Tversky prospect theory: loss aversion + reference-point relativity.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Reference values are 'lodged in a recalcitrant world subject to negotiation' (vs. Skinner's generic paradiastole); Austen as critic — not exponent — of systematic-utilitarian thinking.

tensions.tension_name: Snow's two cultures: incommensurability vs. consilience
tensions.pole_A: Incommensurability (Scarantino-Griffiths Folk vs. Scientific Emotion Project) — the two sides cannot share an object.
tensions.pole_B: Consilience (E. O. Wilson, Pinker reading Austen via Trivers's 'moral emotions') — reductive unification under evolutionary psychology.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Dissolved via rhetorical-situational reframing — neither pure incommensurability nor reductive consilience; qualified-No answer to Snow.

tensions.tension_name: Brain-localization claims vs. rhetorical-historical situations of fear research
tensions.pole_A: Classic laboratory fear studies (Phelps 2000 amygdala-race protocol) localize unconscious racial bias to brain regions while deferring causal explanation of racial slavery.
tensions.pole_B: Racism is located primarily in racist institutions (race-based slavery, Jim Crow); the protocol coincides historically with post-war anti-racism concerns and conflates face-to-face familiarity with televisual celebrity (MLK-JFK pairing).
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: Critical race theory + rhetorical studies supply the missing mediating field; Phelps's amygdala-correlate must be referred to institutions exceeding any brain state.

tensions.tension_name: Reticence as least-sympathy vs. reticence as maximal-credibility
tensions.pole_A: Preston-Hofelich hospital study: reticent patients elicit LEAST observer sympathy; perspective-takers nevertheless prefer them.
tensions.pole_B: Dean's Holocaust-survivor archive: reticence is the post-WWII marker of MAXIMAL authenticity and credibility of suffering.
tensions.resolved_by_gross_at: The disanalogy itself proves the methodological point: 'reticence' is not transparent across cultural-historical situations and must be specified each time; empathy must be theorized as context-sensitive.
